emi: quick bring-up note: nebula-v2 int8 shows parentheses mirroring and CJK quote-order swaps when Arabic/Hebrew spans appear inline with Japanese. Minimal SRT repro below.

emi: SRT sample:
00:00:01,000 --> 00:00:03,000
東京で、 (مرحبا) 「ありがとう」

emi: fp16 detok OK: parentheses kept, corner quotes intact. int8 detok: parentheses reversed and corner quotes swapped. BLEU drop ~4.5 pts on mixed subtitles.

sami: tokenizer IDs same across builds?

emi: yes. tokenization matches. postproc detok bidi reflow seems to run after a C memcpy that drops U+200E/200F on some int8 runs.

akshay: will run kernel byte-trace on staging. infra job queued.

qa-bot: quick reproduce on staging: int8 reproduces bracket flip; fp16/int4 fine. Added failing lines to reg suite.

sami: temporary mitigation: gate detok mirroring for caption routes and flip caption canary to fp16 until fix. Opening ticket to bisect quant transforms.

emi: sample bundle: https://internal.rw/samples/mixed-orient-subtitles.zip

akshay: tracing now, will post results in ~2h.
